description: Attenuation rules (a) to (f) of Sidged L2 for delegated capability tokens. Static checks; signatures are placeholders.

vectors.note: Valid one-hop delegation: narrower resource, fewer rights, smaller budget
Rule (a): iss is not the parent sub
Rule (d): action the parent never granted
Rule (d): resource equal to a parent resource without a wildcard
Rule (d): wildcard child under an exact parent resource widens it
Rule (d): resource outside the parent wildcard
Rule (d): same wildcard resource as the parent
Rule (d): right taken from the second parent right, which has no constraints
Second hop asks for a right its own parent dropped, although the root had it
Rule (f): chain not in root-first order
Rule (f): 17 links in chain; at most 16 are allowed
